Live in the Heart of Dubai Hills: Welcome to Socio Tower

Located in the vibrant Dubai Hills Boulevard, Socio Tower is the ultimate living space for young professionals and millennials. Designed to promote a social and interactive lifestyle, this modern community offers the perfect balance of work, leisure, and connection.

Property Features:

2 Spacious Bedrooms
Fully Furnished & Equipped
Move-in Ready, Vacant Now
Flexible Payment Terms (Multiple Cheques)
Chiller Free
Developed by EMAAR
Corner Unit with Stunning Panoramic Views
Prime Location Next to the Park
Additional Storage Room
Bright & Airy Living Space
Padel Court, Cinema Room & More
Convenient Supermarket within the Building
Premium Amenities in Dubai Hills
Walking Distance to the Mall

Incredible Amenities: Residents enjoy access to an array of top-tier facilities, including a dedicated cinema room, games lounge, cutting-edge gym, library, hidden garden, outdoor spaces, Padel court, and a refreshing swimming pool – all designed to enhance your lifestyle.

Dubai Mall: 16 minutes
